chunk.content: Scenario 3.3.3 Kịch bản kết nối mạng bất thường hoặc nghi vấn C2. Description: Integrated research draft: observed telemetry, inferred correlations, candidate assessments and separate CTI context. Analysis status: draft_reviewable. Observed behavior: PowerShell parent → regsvr32 HTTP /i scriptlet command with /n → encoded PowerShell child; observed regsvr32 port8444 and child PowerShell port80 connections.

scope_limitations: Connections and command URL do not establish HTTP completion, response content, confirmed C2 purpose, exfiltration or bytes transferred.
Network and process identity links are inferred from host/GUID/lifetime; PID fallback stops at next creation/exit and has a bounded age. Ambiguous links remain separate.
Source timestamp conflicts are preserved. Canonical timestamps are not timezone-corrected. Security 5156 is inventoried separately, not counted again as Sysmon connection observations.
CTI facts are publisher-reported external context. They do not establish local host compromise, campaign attribution, HTTP completion or confirmed C2.
